SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN parent_category = 'TV & Video' THEN net_revenue_eur END) / SUM(net_revenue_eur), 1)
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND parent_category IN (
    SELECT parent_category
    FROM sales
    WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY parent_category
    HAVING AVG(net_revenue_eur) > 150
  )
